cards.text: King Solomon is ruling over Israel, and he has chief officials: priests, secretaries, a recorder, a palace manager, a man over the forced labor and Benaiah son of Jehoiada in charge of the army. That's a LOT of job titles. On my cookie planet I'm every single one of them, and I STILL show up late.

Next come twelve governors over all Israel, region by region, and each one provides food for the king and his household for one month of the year. Two of them are married to Solomon's daughters. Twelve men sharing one calendar. I've seen group chats fall apart over less.
Now step back and look at the people of Judah and Israel. They're as numerous as the sand on the seashore.

cards.question: All those people of Judah and Israel are eating and drinking and rejoicing.

cards.text: And Solomon's reign stretches WAY past Israel. He reigns over all the kingdoms from the Euphrates to the land of the Philistines, all the way to the border of Egypt.

cards.question: The kingdoms under Solomon rebel against him every chance they get.

cards.text: Then comes Solomon's food for a single day: fine flour and meal by the cor, oxen, game and fattened poultry, with a hundred sheep on top. I count chocolate chips one at a time, friend, and this kitchen counts OXEN.

cards.question: Solomon has dominion over everything west of the Euphrates, from Tiphsah to Gaza. And he has ___ on all sides.

cards.text: Throughout Solomon's days, Judah and Israel dwell securely from Dan to Beersheba, each man under his own vine and his own fig tree.

Solomon has 12,000 horses, and each month the governors take turns supplying the king's table and the horses' barley and straw, so nothing is lacking. Twelve THOUSAND horses, friend, and I can't keep track of ONE timer.

cards.question: Solomon receives wisdom, exceedingly deep insight and understanding beyond measure, like the sand on the seashore. Who gives it to him?

cards.text: His wisdom is greater than all the men of the East and all the wisdom of Egypt, wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite, and wiser than Heman, Calcol and Darda, the sons of Mahol. Me? I once lost an argument to the dead batteries I shared a junk drawer with.

cards.question: Solomon's fame stays inside Israel's borders.
Solomon's wisdom doesn't stay in his head. What does he do with it?

answers.text: Composes thousands of proverbs and songs
Builds a great library of scrolls

cards.question: Solomon speaks of trees, from the cedar in Lebanon to the hyssop growing in the wall. What else does he teach about?

answers.text: Animals and birds and reptiles and fish
The stars and the moon and the seasons

cards.question: All the kings of the earth hear about Solomon's wisdom. What do they do?

answers.text: Send men to listen to him
Ban his words in their lands
